_why: Every rule in CLAUDE.md and the mechanism that refuses it, checked against the tree by tools/guard/rule_map.py. An entry naming nothing real is refused; a rule with no entry at all is refused; the number with no mechanism may only fall. On 2026-09-20 sixteen of these twenty-eight had nothing behind them, which nobody could see because nobody had counted.

MEASURE, NEVER REASON FROM PLAUSIBILITY.note: a measurement reporting nothing must cite the control that proves the scan can find something; census.py refuses a report whose coverage is not computed from disk

A FIX WITHOUT A GUARD IS NOT A FIX.note: a commit whose diff changes behaviour must touch a guard directory

PROVE EVERY GUARD BY BREAKING IT.note: 175 recorded defects, each re-applied and required to redden its named suite

A CONFIDENT EMPTY RESULT IS A BUG UNTIL.note: and census.py refusal 1: a census that read nothing is refused rather than reported clean

COUNT WHAT YOU EXPECT BEFORE RUNNING THE.note: a rewrite that reaches a file without counting its matches first is refused; it found autoplant.try_one writing a substitution straight out while replant.py, the same function one directory over, had refused an ambiguous find since it was written

A STARTLING MAGNITUDE IS A BUG REPORT.note: a recorded number that moved past its allowance, or did NOT move across a change meant to move it, is refused without a reason; wired into record_run.py and replant.py --owed. The second case was paid for on 2026-09-20: a ratchet re-measured to exactly 103 before and after, and the true number was 64

BUILD GENERAL SYSTEMS, NOT THE USER'S EX.note: a game's identity hardcoded in production code outside src/ctrmap/gamedef is refused; two known sites (ZoneLimitPatch, ZoneLoadingPanel) are named and ratcheted, and a third is refused. Fixing the two is a behaviour change the owner has to check in the game, so it is not slipped into a guard commit

DETANGLE, DO NOT RELOCATE.note: a commit that says it split something and adds production files must show its coupling going down

EXTRACTION IS NOT TESTING.note: a new production class no test names is refused

NEVER HAND-EDIT A MEASUREMENT.note: the baseline's digest is recomputed from the tree, so an edited number is refused

COMMIT BEFORE RUNNING ANYTHING THAT MUTA.note: a frozen-tree measurement refuses to begin on a dirty tree

NEVER EDIT SOURCE WHILE THE SUITE IS RUN.note: a write to anything the build compiles is refused while a battery or mutation run holds its lock

RECORD TRAPS YOU PAID FOR, WITH THE COST.note: a falling ceiling on plants whose why records no number

NOTHING IS FIXED UNTIL THE SECOND ONE IS.note: a detector or a convention is refused without a No-refusal: line saying why the point of action cannot refuse

ASK WHAT THE CHEAPEST WAY TO SATISFY YOU.note: a commit adding a guard must write down the cheapest way to make that guard go quiet

AN UNMEASURABLE QUANTITY IS NOT A SMALL.note: a fan-out whose width cannot be read is refused rather than assumed small; shellin.unreadable does the same for a tool input

A QUERY THAT CANNOT READ ITS SUBJECT MUS.note: one probe in tools/hooks/liveness.py that returns its reason, and a refusal for any other spelling in any .py or .ps1 here

A REMEDY'S EXIT CODE ANSWERS ITS OWN QUE.note: reading $? after a pipeline into a filter is refused; ${PIPESTATUS[0]} is not

A RUN THAT KNOWS WHAT IT MISSED GOES BAC.note: and census.py, which refuses a report whose scope was not covered - stopping the search fails one, filing the result fails the other

A CLAIM ABOUT WHAT YOU DID NOT OPEN IS A.note: vouching for what the diff did not open needs Reviewed: n/n by a path that exists

DO THE WORK MECHANICALLY; AN AGENT FAN-O.note: caps agents, workflows and fan-out width, and refuses a width it cannot read

DO THE WORK MECHANICALLY.note: the owner's own wording of the same rule; the same hook answers both

MAKE IT IMPOSSIBLE AT THE POINT OF ACTIO.note: the kind of guard a fix carries must be named, and a detector must say why a refusal was impossible

NEVER PUSH WITHOUT EXPLICIT PER-PUSH APP.note: a push needs a token naming THIS commit; one more commit expires it

FINISH CHANGES BEFORE STARTING A LONG ME.note: OUTSTANDING.md and the plant-proof digest both gate a frozen-tree measurement

FEATURES LIVE IN THEIR OWN UI AREA.note: a new item on the window that owns the menu bar must say why it is not a tab; MainframeShapeTest caps how many the bar may hold

GAME DATA IS READ-ONLY.note: a write under a protected root is refused from any tool; reads are untouched

THE OWNER DOES THE IN-APP AND IN-GAME TE.note: a commit claiming an in-game result is refused unless it quotes the owner
